header.title: How to Test a Dishwasher Water Inlet Valve
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions on how to diagnose a faulty dishwasher water inlet valve. You'll learn to safely lock out the dishwasher, access the valve, and test its solenoids and seal to determine if it's functioning correctly.

steps.description: Disconnect the dishwasher from its power and water supply before starting work.
actions: Locate angle stop under kitchen sink

steps.description: This step involves removing the kick panel to access and disconnect the valve.
actions: Do not pull on the wires

steps.description: Test the solenoids using an ohmmeter to check for failure.
actions: Hook up the ohmmeter to the terminals.

steps.description: This step involves testing the dishwasher inlet valve seal by inspecting and cleaning the screened-washer, and potentially replacing the valve if necessary.
actions: Unfasten the supply at the valve
